d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how a dramatic shift in modern warfare is rapidly altering the security landscape across Africa as drones transform from high-tech government assets into accessible, lethal tools for non-state actors. According to a recent Africa Center for Strategic Studies report, drone-related conflict caused over 2,100 violent incidents and an estimated 9,000 deaths in just one year—tripling 2024’s fatalities.
